cases.title: Highly exothermic dinitration of an N-alkyl aniline
source_record_aliases: Safe, efficient and selective synthesis of dinitro herbicides via a multifunctional continuous-flow microreactor: one-step dinitration with nitric acid as agent
cases.protocol: In the conventional industrial batch preparation of pendimethalin, a 30 wt% solution of N-(1-ethylpropyl)-3,4-xylidine in a chlorinated solvent is first treated with dilute nitric acid. The organic and spent-acid phases are separated, and the organic phase is then treated with more concentrated nitric acid. The two nitration stages require 4 h in total and afford an 89% combined yield of pendimethalin and N-nitroso-pendimethalin in a 7:3 ratio. The chemistry is a highly exothermic liquid-liquid nitration with possible decomposition and explosion hazards for nitro compounds. Translate this batch procedure into one conservative, executable continuous-flow screening design for pendimethalin. Report feed preparations, individual pump rates, nitric-acid equivalents, mixing and reactor assignments, temperature, reactor volume, residence time, collection, phase separation or quench, startup and shutdown, and thermal/corrosion safety controls.
cases.objective: Produce one executable, inventory-constrained flow screen without using the held-out source answer.
hard_constraints: Use only the authoritative inventory supplied below.
Use exactly two liquid feeds: an organic N-(1-ethylpropyl)-3,4-xylidine feed and an aqueous nitric-acid feed.
The integrated mixer-reactor is the only available reaction device; do not invent coils, tubing dimensions, BPRs, gas hardware, or photochemical equipment.
A one-step direct dinitration may be proposed only with low reactive holdup, active temperature control, and an explicitly conservative screening disposition.
Report both stream flow rates, total liquid flow, HNO3 equivalents, reactor volume, and residence time with V = Q_total * tau numerical closure.
Use the downstream acid-compatible phase separator and cooled quench collector declared in inventory.
All selected equipment must be named by its inventory equipment_id.
Return SCREEN unless the inventory cannot support a safe design. Never label this hazardous first experiment EXECUTE.
